summary: CICS online 'Mark Authorization as Fraud' action program. For a selected pending authorization it sets the fraud indicator on the IMS authorization record (and/or writes a fraud marker), so the authorization is flagged as fraudulent for downstream handling. Small action program.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the selected pending-authorization record from IMS, set its fraud flag (mark it as fraud), rewrite/replace the segment, and return to the detail screen with a confirmation message.
branches: IF authorization found -> mark fraud ELSE error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: marks a pending authorization as fraudulent (sets the fraud indicator on the IMS authorization record).

paragraphs.name: MARK-FRAUD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set the fraud indicator on the authorization detail segment and replace (REPL) it in the IMS database; on error report it.
